Balances.description: Which balance-sheet amounts the ratios use (SPEC-0007 R2). No default: the analyst chooses.

oneOf.description: Balances at the end of the period (`closing`).
Average of the opening and closing balances: (opening + closing) / 2. Needs `opening`.

CapitalStructureBalances.description: Balance-sheet amounts at one date, in currency units.

equity.description: Shareholders' equity, in currency units. May be negative.

net_financial_position.description: Net financial position with its composition, in currency units.

non_current_liabilities.description:
Non-current (medium and long-term) liabilities, financial and operating, in currency
units.

NetFinancialPosition.description:
The net financial position with its composition (SPEC-0007 R6). Fairmark adds what is
given and does not choose which items are included.

cash.description: Cash and cash equivalents, in currency units, subtracted from the gross debt.

gross_debt.description: Gross financial debt (bank loans, bonds and other borrowings), in currency units.

other_items.description: Other items included by the analyst, each added with its sign. Default: none.

NfpItem.description: One item of the net financial position other than gross debt and cash.

amount.description:
Amount in currency units, added to the net financial position: positive for debt-like
items, negative for financial assets.

name.description: What the item is, for example "lease liabilities" or "derivative assets".

balances.description: Balances used by the ratios: `closing`, or `average` of opening and closing.

closing.description: Balance sheet at the end of the period.

opening.description:
Balance sheet at the start of the period. Required with average balances; not used
with closing balances.
